messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Dedicated pool 'dedicated-pool-alpha' GPU saturation. Queue length 12,400 requests (tokens), enqueue rate spike x3 over baseline. Autoscaler errors observed. Impacting reserved tenants (some 500+ requests queued). Monitor: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/d/pool-alpha

sarah: ack I’m oncall. I’ll start triage. Can someone paste the per-tenant reservation breakdown?

aj: query in PromQL ->
```
sum by(tenant) (dedicated_gpu_usage{pool="alpha",job_type!~"batch"})
```
results: acme-corp=48 GPUs, beta-llc=6, internal-eval=2, others small. acme-corp is heavy.

mike: autoscaler logs showing repeated 403 from cloud API (rate_limited) and then hit max_replicas: 80. excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T22:07:03Z ERROR autoscaler.cloud: request failed status=403 body="rate exceeded"
2026-03-15T22:09:12Z INFO autoscaler: desired=92, max_replicas=80, scaling_blocked=true
```

emily: oh — so autoscaler wanted to scale but hit our policy cap + cloud rate limit. That explains queue growth. Any evictions?

mike: yes, eviction events for low-priority pods started at 22:05 UTC. noisy-neighbor patterns: single tenant (acme-corp) holds steady high allocation + many small long-lived sessions.

sarah: initial impact assessment: user-facing latency spikes for enterprise tenants; some requests returning 429/RateLimit or long tail timeouts. severity: S2 -> escalating toward S1 if we can’t get queues down in 20m.

james: I'm seeing support tickets from three enterprise customers about timeouts (inc: #6789, #6790). Marking acme-corp as P0 for mitigation.

emily: mitigation plan (short): 1) throttle acme-corp transiently at API gateway (qps cap) 2) move some acme batch jobs to dedicated-pool-beta (cold spare) 3) bump autoscaler max_replicas for pool-alpha to 120 as temporary emergency 4) retry autoscaler cloud calls with exponential backoff fix. Which can we do right now?

aj: I can push the gateway qps cap. command: `./infra/tools/gatewayctl set-rate --tenant acme-corp --qps 40`

mike: I can add 8 nodes to pool-beta and trigger migration of 10 running sessions (low-priority) -> people should be aware of transient restarts.

support-bot: Notifying affected customers: Acme (ticket #6789) updated with "We are experiencing high latency; mitigation in progress".

sarah: do the gateway throttle first, then migration. Aj, apply throttle now and confirm metrics.

aj: applied throttle at 22:12 UTC. Response codes from acme dropped from 18% 500/timeout to 2% errors within 90s. link: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/d/tenant-acme

mike: started migration of 10 low-priority sessions at 22:15 UTC. Adding nodes to pool-beta now.

emily: autoscaler config change request: temporarily set max_replicas=120 and enable backoff fix. Does oncall have permission to change?

sarah: I have permission to change emergency scaling caps. Making change now.

sarah: increased max_replicas to 120 at 22:18 UTC and toggled emergency-backoff to enabled.

mike: cloud API still returning intermittent 429s but backoff seems reducing retries. Desired replicas now 98, actual ramping up to 90+, queue length falling.

incident-bot: :zap: Pool-alpha metrics: queue_length=2,800 -> 650 in 20m; avg token latency 1.8s -> 0.4s.

james: support update posted to customers (Acme, Beta-LLC, Enterprise-X). Sent status note + link to status page.

emily: long-term followups we need: - autoscaler should surface cloud quota errors to ops and should have configurable emergency override for reserved pools - implement per-tenant fairness caps at scheduler level - reserved pool accounting to prevent noisy neighbor from blasting capacity - improve alerting thresholds to detect early queue growth. Assign owners?

sarah: yes. I’ll take autoscaler visibility. Mike you own scheduler per-tenant caps. Aj look at gateway soft-limits and graceful shedding. James will run customer comms playbook.

mike: noted. Creating follow-up tickets: INFRA-2334 (tenant caps), INFRA-2335 (migration tooling improvements).

support-bot: Tickets linked: #INFRA-2334, #INFRA-2335. Notifying SE to coordinate with Acme for quota optimization.

sarah: final update at 22:52 UTC: queue stabilized at ~300, latency back to SLOs for most tenants, acme-corp temporarily throttled and migrated workloads. We will keep pool-alpha on throttled guard for 2 hours. Incident downgraded to monitoring.

emily: recommend postmortem and a follow-up customer-facing RCA for Acme. Can we also request temporary cloud quota raise to avoid frequent 403s?

sarah: filing postmortem and RCA. Raising to support for quota increase now. Thanks all — great coordination. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed -> initial mitigations applied, follow-ups created, monitoring for 4h.
